dates_external_autopub_admin_wire_provisional: PROVISIONAL bodies of the external admin contract v2
(D-149, T-908): the review fields of the external event list and detail, the re-research route,
the corrections queue and its decision, the mark_reviewed / clear_reviewed commands and an update
that approves a correction.

NOT CORE'S BODIES. Written by the Webadmin lane on 2026-11-02 from the specification
(team/handoffs/areyouin-autopublish-research.md, "Admin wire") while Core-B
(claude/areyouin-autopub-20261102-core) finalises the contract in docs/DATES_EXTERNAL_ADMIN_V1.md.
Nothing here proves what Core serves.

How:   the list and detail files are Core's genuine P1 bodies
       tests/fixtures/dates_external_admin_wire/admin-list-admin.json and admin-detail-admin.json
       (byte copies of FINAL E1 Core 51140a6f, see docs/DATES_EXTERNAL_CONSOLE.md) with the v2 keys
       added; every other file is written from the specification. The envelope, ids and
       `server_now` (1790000000) follow Core's normalised capture. Names the specification does not
       fix are the lane's guesses and are marked PROVISIONAL in the code that reads them:
       - the re-research job id prefix `rck_`;
       - the refusal statuses (409 open / budget, 404 unavailable, 409 correction already decided);
       - the correction list page keys `page`, `limit`, `total` and the rows under `corrections`;
       - the re-research and decision receipts: the specification writes `{recheck_id, status}`, but
         the legacy envelope already has a top-level `status` (200), so the job and the correction are
         nested (`recheck`, `correction`); flat `recheck_status` / `correction_status` is read too;
       - the review command receipt (the command receipt plus `admin_review`, revision + 1);
       - the update receipt's `correction_id` / `correction_status` echo;
       - the change-set field names (`start_at`, `is_free`) and the job reason codes.

Re-pin: when Core-B's genuine admin bodies exist, vendor them as a corpus of their own (a byte copy
with its manifest, like tests/fixtures/dates_external_pins_wire), point
tests/datesExternalReview.test.mts at it, move the three routes out of PROVISIONAL_ROUTES in
tests/datesAdminProjection.test.mts, and delete this directory.

admin-list-v2.json                       a row not reviewed: possible duplicate, 1 open correction, 2 open reports, a running re-research
admin-list-v2-reviewed.json              the same row reviewed, nothing open, the last re-research applied
admin-detail-v2.json                     the detail with the mark, three jobs (applied with a change set, failed, no change with an unknown reason) and two corrections (pending, rejected)
admin-recheck-queued.json                dates_external_event_recheck: the queued job
admin-recheck-open-denied.json           ... refused: a job is open (409 dates-recheck-open)
admin-recheck-budget-paused-denied.json  ... refused: the research budget stop (409 dates-research-budget-paused)
admin-recheck-unavailable-denied.json    ... refused: not re-researchable (404 dates-recheck-unavailable)
admin-correction-list-pending.json       dates_external_correction_list, status pending
admin-correction-decide-rejected.json    dates_external_correction_decide: rejected
admin-correction-decide-decided-denied.json  ... refused: already decided (409 dates-correction-state-invalid)
admin-command-mark-reviewed.json         dates_external_event_command mark_reviewed
admin-command-clear-reviewed.json        dates_external_event_command clear_reviewed
admin-update-correction-approved.json    dates_external_event_update with correction_id
